'''2012 US Nationals Day 2 Jake Nelson DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jake Nelson]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V) (Dark)|VB4-D-combatreadiness-pre.gif|label=Combat Readiness / Full Scale Alert (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
